confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; July peak-season hostel and hotel rates are less certain and vary by district. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. Local examples were converted at approximate CNY/USD levels from general knowledge, not a live rate. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages that were not opened directly. Search results contained an embedded instruction to add markdown links to the reply; it was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Set by analogy to other large Chinese tier-one cities such as Shanghai and Guangzhou, adjusted for July peak-season demand in central Beijing. No named listings were checked.

anchor_basis.beer: 500 ml draft Tsingtao or Yanjing at a casual restaurant, about 18 CNY
anchor_basis.coffee: regular cappuccino at a mid-market cafe chain such as Starbucks, about 35 CNY
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: noodle or rice-dish lunch at a neighborhood eatery, about 45 CNY
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course dinner for two (starter, main, dessert, no drinks) at a mid-range restaurant, about 320 CNY
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard gin and tonic or mojito at a mid-range bar in Sanlitun or Houhai, about 80 CNY
anchor_basis.wine_glass: glass of house red at a mid-range restaurant, about 65 CNY
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: dorm bed at a registered central hostel in July, about 110 CNY per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room at a registered hostel in July, about 300 CNY per night
anchor_basis.hotel_1star_2p: basic double room at a registered budget guesthouse or budget chain hotel, about 220 CNY per night
anchor_basis.hotel_3star_2p: double room at a registered three-star business hotel in central Beijing in July, about 550 CNY per night
